function.name: releases_api_ReleasesApi_post_release
function.description: Creates a new software release entry in the system, allowing tracking and management of software versions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

version.description: The version identifier for the software release, following semantic versioning, e.g., '1.0.0', '2.1.3'.

release_date.description: The official release date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-03-15'.

description.description: A brief description of the release and its main features or changes.

is_stable.description: A flag indicating whether the release is considered stable and production-ready.

function.name: releases_api_ReleasesApi_put_release
function.description: Updates the details of an existing release using the specified release ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

releaseId.description: The unique identifier of the release to be updated.

release_name.description: The new name of the release.

release_date.description: The updated release date in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

is_active.description: Flag indicating whether the release is currently active.

version.description: The new version string for the release.

function.name: releases_api_ReleasesApi_get_all_releases
function.description: Retrieve a list of releases with optional filters such as name, start time, and date range. The endpoint can be used to create, update, delete, and fetch details for existing releases. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

releaseId.description: A unique identifier for each release.

name.description: The exact name of the release to retrieve, e.g., 'Release-161'.

start.description: The start time of the release, represented as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

_from.description: Filter to include only releases with a start time greater than or equal to this UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

to.description: Filter to include only releases with a start time less than or equal to this UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

maxResults.description: The maximum number of releases to retrieve. Use a positive integer to limit results.
